{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.replace('$', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_filtered = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute the fraction who converted
n_total = len(df_filtered)
n_converted = df_filtered['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Return results
n_total, n_converted, fraction_converted"}
